tweet.text:
I don't love how some people on here make it seem like making life changing money in crypto / memecoins is easy

its totally possible, but its not "easy"

It took me 3 years of trading consistently to build up the bag I have, and it's significant

one of the worst things you can do as a trader is feel bad when you see these crazy pnls and get fomo from people

most people are larping and are trash at trading but they want to grow so they fake everything they do

the market overall is pretty manipulated, especially now that everything is a CTO or just a straight rug

basically what happens is someone will launch a coin, sell, they will be the ones who CTO, they have no responsibility, they will pump it up, and then dump on everyone, rinse, repeat

you can still make money trading big event memes and any other meta that comes around, but unless you have insider info that a team is going to take a coin seriously, you're just hyper gambling on new pairs

which is fine, but...

there are people who sit on their PC 24/7 with tools and all the time in the world who are ruthless at cooking in this market

if you're not willing to put in the work to give yourself an edge, the people who want it more than you are going to thank you for being their exit liq

my advice is to get into good groups, follow profitable wallets, find out what kind of a trader YOU are, come up with a strategy, and realize it is going to take time for you to find your edge

I lose all the time, but I win more than I lose

sorry for the brain dump but just wanted to share what I see, and give everyone a boost to work harder and become the best version of yourself to give yourself the best chance at winning here
